result.name: Otvoreno
result.oneLiner: A conversion-first single page where one live status chip — wired to the same JSON-LD the search engine reads — anchors a phone-native menu, one-tap booking and 10-minutes-from-the-airport directions.
result.rationale: Mon Ami's problem is not taste, it is retrieval. The restaurant is number one in Velika Gorica, MICHELIN Selected 2026, 13,5/20 and two toques at Gault&Millau — and its homepage body is literally an empty paragraph, there is no menu page at all, /jelovnik/ returns 404, the hours exist on exactly one page in one sentence, and the footer still says 2020. Every euro of that reputation currently leaks into Google's own listing card and into a third-party iframe on skubacz.pl. So this concept is not a mood piece; it is an instrument for the three jobs a guest actually has, in the order they have them: are you open right now, what do you cook and what does it cost, get me a table or get me there. Hence the name Otvoreno — the concept is built around the single chip that answers the first question before the page has finished painting, and that chip is derived from the very same openingHoursSpecification object that ships as JSON-LD, so the site and the rich result can never disagree again. Everything else earns its place against those jobs. The airport positioning that MICHELIN and the restaurant both lean on — od usputnog prolaznika do putnika koji između dva leta želi nešto dobro pojesti — becomes a real card with the 35-minute bus, the roughly 2 EUR fare and the 3-minute walk, not prose. The 96 EUR scampi, which today reads as a single portion and is genuinely frightening, gets an explicit cijena po kg pill and a weight calculator. The twenty gallery photographs nobody has ever seen, numbers 21 through 40, become the visual body of the page. And the coast-meets-continent founding story, the Skradin olive oil and the Vukomeričke gorice cuvée — the things no competitor in Zagreb County can copy — sit below the conversion layer where they close the sale rather than block it. It looks 2026 because the surface is precise: a real spacing scale, oklch tokens, subgrid-aligned prices, View Transitions, starting-style dialogs. It is right for this restaurant because every photograph, dish, price and sentence in it already belongs to Mon Ami.

palette.use: Body background. A near-black with a faint cold blue cast so it sits under, not against, the black reflective plates in gallery 18, 21 and 40. Never pure black — pure black makes photo edges invisible and smears on OLED during scroll.
Cards, the sticky mobile action bar base, menu category headers, the dialog. A 1px top hairline at oklch(1 0 0 / 0.10) gives depth instead of a shadow.

The menu section flips to a warm cream paper island in BOTH themes via a local color-scheme of light. This is the exact cream the real logo PNG sits on, so the lockup stops looking like a pasted sticker, and prices read like a printed jelovnik.
Headlines and body on dark surfaces. Warm-white rather than blue-white; 15.8:1 on surface, far past the 4.5:1 minimum.
Descriptions, English dish names, captions, meta labels. 6.9:1 on surface, safe down to 13px.
Text inside the cream menu island. 12.4:1 on surface-paper.

The restaurant's own #b22047 re-derived in oklch and lifted for contrast. Primary buttons, active filter chips, the underline on section numerals, the price of a chef recommendation. Paired with oklch(0.98 0.01 85) text at 5.1:1.
Button pressed state, dark-on-claret borders, and the focus-ring offset colour when the ring sits on a claret surface.
The Skradin olive-oil thread: the olive-oil card border, the gluten-free and vegetarian diet tags, the olive-leaf divider glyph. Taken from the bottle green of their own oil. 8.3:1 on surface.
The live status chip when open, plus the pulsing dot. A fixed pair in both themes, verified at 4.5:1 against surface AND surface-paper because this is safety-critical information.
Amber when under 60 minutes remain; desaturated to oklch(0.62 0.03 75) when hard closed. Never red — red on a restaurant site reads as an error, not a schedule.
Every 1px rule, card border and table separator, plus the inset ring around each photo so black-ground images do not bleed into the black page. Becomes oklch(0.88 0.01 85) in the light theme.
MICHELIN, Gault&Millau and Top-100 badge text and their 1px borders only. Restrained, never a fill — the restaurant is Selected, not starred, and a gold fill would overclaim.

typography.displayFont: Instrument Serif — 400 regular plus 400 italic, subsets latin AND latin-ext (mandatory for č ć đ š ž). Used ONLY at 26px and above: H1, H2, section numerals, pull-quotes, and the English dish name set in italic. Never used for UI.
typography.bodyFont: Schibsted Grotesk — variable 400/500/600/700, subsets latin AND latin-ext. All body copy, nav, buttons, labels, dish names, form fields. Third face: Geist Mono 400/500 (latin-ext) used exclusively for numbers — prices, the live clock, the hours table, the euro-per-kilogram calculator, the phone number. Load order: preconnect to fonts.gstatic.com with crossorigin, then ONE combined Google Fonts link with display=swap; preload only the Schibsted Grotesk 400 latin-ext woff2, with crossorigin.
typography.pairingRationale: The logo Mon Ami already owns is a letterspaced warm-grey serif wordmark whose O is a drawn plate, so a high-contrast modern serif is the only honest display voice; Instrument Serif's hairlines and tight apertures read as expensive at 60px and cost exactly one 400 weight, which is all a single-file no-build site can afford. Schibsted Grotesk supplies what the serif cannot: a neutral, slightly condensed, product-grade UI voice with excellent small-size legibility in Croatian, so buttons, filter chips and allergen labels look like software rather than a menu card. Geist Mono as a third, numbers-only face is what makes the page feel engineered: every price, closing time and kilogram figure sits on identical advance widths, so a 60-dish price column aligns with no alignment hacks and the ticking status clock never reflows. Three faces, three jobs, zero overlap — and the serif-versus-grotesk contrast, soft warmth against cold precision, is literally the restaurant's own coast-meets-continent thesis rendered in type.
typography.scale: Fluid 320 to 1440px; every preferred value carries a rem term so 200 percent browser text-zoom still scales — never a bare vw. --step-h1: clamp(2.5rem, 1.857rem + 3.214vw, 4.75rem) = 40 to 76px. --step-h2: clamp(1.75rem, 1.464rem + 1.429vw, 2.75rem) = 28 to 44px. --step-h3: clamp(1.25rem, 1.143rem + 0.536vw, 1.625rem) = 20 to 26px. --step-body: clamp(1rem, 0.964rem + 0.179vw, 1.125rem) = 16 to 18px. --step-small: clamp(0.8125rem, 0.795rem + 0.089vw, 0.875rem) = 13 to 14px. --step-micro: 0.75rem fixed, uppercase, 0.08em tracking, labels only. Line-heights: h1 0.98, h2 1.06, h3 1.22, body 1.55, small 1.45. Measure capped at 62ch. text-wrap balance on h1/h2/h3 and dish names; text-wrap pretty on paragraphs, which fails safe in Firefox. Fallback stacks carry size-adjust overrides generated with Fontaine — Instrument Serif to Georgia at about 101 percent, Schibsted Grotesk to Arial at about 97 percent — to hold CLS near zero. Spacing is a strict 4px base scale: 4, 8, 12, 16, 24, 32, 48, 64, 96, 128 exposed as --s-1 through --s-10; section block padding is clamp(4rem, 2.5rem + 7.5vw, 8rem).

sections.title: Sticky chrome: header, language toggle, mobile action bar
sections.purpose: Keep the two conversion actions and the open/closed truth permanently one tap away at every scroll position, without ever obscuring keyboard focus.
sections.layout: DESKTOP HEADER: 72px tall, position sticky top 0, background surface at 72 percent alpha with backdrop-filter blur(16px) saturate(140%) plus the webkit prefix, and a 1px bottom hairline that only appears after 24px of scroll, toggled by an IntersectionObserver on a 1px sentinel rather than a scroll listener. Grid columns: logo 180px, nav 1fr centred, status chip auto, HR/EN auto, Rezerviraj auto. Nav is anchor links only: Jelovnik, Priča, Vino i ulje, Galerija, Dolazak. The logo is the real logo-monami.png with its cream background removed and re-coloured to ink via a CSS mask so it works on dark, falling back to an inline SVG wordmark. MOBILE: header collapses to 56px with logo plus status chip; nav moves into a dialog sheet opened by a 44px hamburger. MOBILE ACTION BAR: position fixed, inset-block-end 0, grid with two equal columns, gap 8px, padding 12px and padding-block-end max(12px, env(safe-area-inset-bottom)), background surface-raised at 85 percent with backdrop blur and a top hairline. Left button Rezerviraj stol filled claret; right button Nazovi outlined, an href of tel:+38516213333. Both 48px tall, well past the 24px WCAG 2.5.8 minimum. Hidden at min-width 48rem. Body gets matching padding-block-end so the footer is never covered, and root gets scroll-padding-block-start 84px and scroll-padding-block-end 88px so anchor jumps and keyboard focus never land under either sticky bar, satisfying WCAG 2.4.11 via technique C43. LANGUAGE: a native popover using popovertarget containing HR / EN plus the Auto / Svijetlo / Tamno theme radio group; switching language swaps textContent from one inline JS dictionary keyed by data-i18n, updates documentElement.lang and pushes a lang query param, all wrapped in document.startViewTransition so the page crossfades in 180ms.
sections.copyDirection: Button labels exactly: Rezerviraj stol and Nazovi. English: Book a table and Call. Nav in Croatian only in the HR view. The header must never say Naslovnica — it is a one-pager.

sections.title: Hero — Riba s Jadrana, u srcu Turopolja
sections.purpose: Answer name, cuisine, place, standing, open-status and next action inside one mobile viewport with no scroll, and land LCP under 2.5 seconds.
sections.layout: Full-viewport-minus-header section, min-height 100svh minus 56px on mobile. Background is a real img element, not a CSS background: gallery photo 02, the grilled squid with blitva and oil being poured over a near-black ground, positioned absolute inset 0, object-fit cover, object-position 60% 50%, explicit width and height attributes, decoding async, fetchpriority high, never lazy, served from a picture element with AVIF then WebP then JPEG sources and an art-directed 3:4 crop under 40rem. Over it a three-stop scrim: linear-gradient to top from oklch(0.16 0.012 250 / 0.92) at 0 percent, to 0.55 alpha at 45 percent, to 0.15 alpha at 100 percent — this is what buys 4.5:1 on the headline without flattening the photograph. CONTENT sits bottom-left, max-width 62ch, stacked with 24px gaps: first an eyebrow row of three hairline pills at --step-micro reading MICHELIN GUIDE 2026 · SELECTED, GAULT&MILLAU 13,5/20 and NAJBOLJI U VELIKOJ GORICI, in gold text with a gold 1px border and no fill; then the H1 in Instrument Serif at --step-h1 reading Riba s Jadrana, line break, u srcu Turopolja, with a claret underline on Turopolja; then one 18px line reading Obiteljski restoran od 1997. Trg kralja Tomislava 26, deset minuta od Zračne luke Zagreb; then THE STATUS CHIP, a 40px pill on surface-raised with a 1px hairline containing an 8px pulsing dot and Geist Mono text that reads Otvoreno — do 23:00, or Otvoreno još 45 min, or Zatvoreno — otvaramo u utorak u 11:00, implemented as a button that scroll-links to the full hours table; then an action row of a filled claret Rezerviraj stol at 52px and a ghost Pogledaj jelovnik at 52px. On desktop a fourth element pins bottom-right: a vertical Geist Mono credit at 12px and 40 percent opacity reading gallery/02 · jadranske lignje sa žara, which quietly signals that the photography is the restaurant's own.
sections.copyDirection: Croatian only in the HR view. The H1 is a new line assembled from the restaurant's own vocabulary and must contain both Jadran and Turopolje, because that duality is the business. The subline must carry 1997, the street address and the airport, because those are the three facts that convert. Never write Michelin star anywhere — the badge says Selected. English H1: Adriatic fish, in the heart of Turopolje.

sections.title: Utility strip — four answers, no scrolling
sections.purpose: Absorb every question that currently forces a guest to phone or to hunt down the old Kontakt page.
sections.layout: Directly under the hero, a four-column grid on desktop using repeat(4, 1fr) with a 1px gap over a hairline-coloured background so the cells read as one ruled table, collapsing to two-by-two under 48rem and staying two-by-two on the smallest phones. Each cell has 24px padding, a --step-micro uppercase label in ink-muted, then the value in Geist Mono at --step-h3. Cell one, RADNO VRIJEME, shows uto–sub 11–23 · pon 11–16:30 · ned zatvoreno with a chevron that expands the full per-day table inline in a details element animated with starting-style. Cell two, REZERVACIJE, shows +385 1 6213 333 as a tel link with 091 5444 715 beneath at --step-small. Cell three, ADRESA, shows Trg kralja Tomislava 26, Velika Gorica as selectable text plus an Upute link to a maps URL, with no iframe anywhere. Cell four, KAPACITET, shows 70 mjesta · separe za 10 · natkrivena terasa. The whole strip uses content-visibility auto with contain-intrinsic-size.
sections.copyDirection: The per-day table is mandatory and must override the restaurant's own misleading one-liner, because Monday is a short day rather than 11–23. Add one line under the table: Nedjeljom i blagdanom ne radimo. Under Rezervacije add: Za grupe veće od 10 osoba javite se telefonom.

sections.title: Jelovnik — the whole menu, in HTML, on a cream paper island
sections.purpose: Fix the single biggest failure on the current site: 60-plus real dishes with real prices, genuinely pleasant to browse on a phone, and fully indexable as monami.hr content.
sections.layout: A full-bleed section that flips to a local color-scheme of light on surface-paper, with 48px rounded top and bottom corners so it reads as a sheet laid on the dark page. STICKY CATEGORY RAIL: directly beneath the site header, a horizontally scrollable chip rail with scroll-snap-type x proximity, hidden scrollbar and edge fade masks, carrying the eleven real categories — Preporuka kuće, Hladna predjela, Topla predjela i rižota, Jela od mesa, Jela od riba, Prilozi, Salate, Slastice, Bez glutena, Vegetarijanski, Kruh i umaci. The active chip is claret-filled and tracked by an IntersectionObserver on the category headings; tapping a chip scroll-snaps that category to the top. DIET FILTERS: a second row of toggle chips — Bez glutena, Vegetarijanski, Riba, Meso — implemented as checkboxes plus a has() selector on the list container, so filtering is pure CSS and costs zero INP. DISH ROW: each dish is a list item on a three-column subgrid inheriting the parent grid-template-columns of name 1fr, tags auto, price 8ch, so names, tags and prices align across every card in every category without per-card tuning. Name in Schibsted Grotesk 600; English name directly beneath in Instrument Serif italic at --step-small in ink-muted; price in Geist Mono 500, right-aligned, tabular-nums. Chef-recommended dishes carry a small claret preporuka šefa tag and special offers a gold posebna ponuda tag. PER-KILOGRAM DISHES get their own treatment: the price cell shows 96,00 € with a claret slash-kg suffix and an inline po kilogramu pill, and tapping it opens a popover with a 0,2 to 1,2 kg range input and a live Geist Mono readout such as 0,45 kg je oko 43,20 €, which single-handedly defuses the most alarming thing on the current menu. PHOTOGRAPHY: exactly six dishes get a 96px one-to-one thumbnail — crni rižoto, dimljene dagnje, carpaccio s tartufom, beefsteak u umaku od tartufa, riblja plata za dvoje and skradinska torta — everything else is text, keeping the section under 300KB. Tapping a thumbnail opens a dialog with the full 16:9 photo, using view-transition-name on the thumbnail so the image morphs into place. Each category block uses content-visibility auto with contain-intrinsic-size 1200px. A seasonal note is pinned at the top of Jela od riba in a hairline box.
sections.copyDirection: Croatian dish name primary, English secondary — and the English must be corrected from the ordering platform's broken strings, which currently include Prshutto, french frie, cackerels, bouzzara and Beefsteak salad mislabelled onto the fuži. Prices exactly as on the live system with the Croatian comma decimal, for example 26,50 €. Per-kilogram note: Cijena je po kilogramu. Vagamo pred vama. Fish disclaimer: Svježa divlja bijela riba mijenja se prema dnevnom ulovu — škrpina, brancin, kovač, zubatac. Pitajte osoblje za današnju ponudu i cijenu. Section heading Jelovnik with a subline Zadnji put ažurirano plus a date — the antidote to a footer frozen at 2020.

sections.title: Rezervacija — the dialog and its section anchor
sections.purpose: Make booking a first-class, obviously completable action for a restaurant that today offers no booking path at all.
sections.layout: A slim anchor section so both the header nav and the sticky bar have a real destination, containing a two-column card. LEFT, the form: Datum as a native date input with min set to today; Vrijeme as a select populated by JS from the real hours object, so Monday never offers 20:00 and Sunday is disabled outright; Broj osoba as a segmented control from 1 to 8 plus a 9-plus option; Ime; Telefon; and a textarea with field-sizing auto labelled Napomena za alergije, dječju stolicu ili separe. Submit posts to a mail or Formspree endpoint and the phone number stays visible at every step. Opening the same form from the sticky bar calls dialog.showModal for free focus trapping and an inert background, entering with starting-style plus transition-behavior allow-discrete on display and overlay, animating translateY 16px and opacity over 220ms. If a third-party widget is ever added it must be injected only on dialog open, to protect both INP and LCP. RIGHT, three hairline reassurance rows: Za 9 i više osoba, separe za 10 ili svadbe — nazovite nas; Vegetarijanska, veganska i bezglutenska jela pripremamo svaki dan; Terasa je natkrivena i grijana. Under 48rem the form becomes one column and the reassurance rows move above the submit button. Validation is native constraint validation styled with the user-invalid pseudo-class, with no JS validator.
sections.copyDirection: Heading Rezervirajte stol. Sub: Rezervacija je poželjna, osobito vikendom. Button: Pošalji zahtjev za rezervaciju — explicitly a request rather than a confirmation, because bookings are handled by phone. Success state: Hvala. Javljamo se telefonom u roku od nekoliko sati. Ako vam se žuri, nazovite 01 6213 333.

sections.title: Priča — 1997, dvije kuhinje pod istim krovom
sections.purpose: Convert a browser into a believer using the one asset no competitor can copy: a true family story with named people.
sections.layout: Dark again, on a twelve-column grid. Left five columns hold a portrait-orientation image — gallery 30, the chef holding up a whole octopus, which is the only vertical frame in the entire library and therefore the only one that fits a portrait slot natively — with a 1px inset ring and a Geist Mono caption. Right seven columns, offset downward by 96px so the two blocks interlock rather than sit in a row, hold an H2, three short paragraphs and then a two-column fact grid reading Osnovano 1997, Obitelj Ceronja, Chef Goran Marko Beus and 70 mjesta. Beneath, full width, a pull-quote in Instrument Serif at --step-h2 with a claret vertical rule, attributed to Bruno Ceronja. Below that a three-up recognition row: MICHELIN Selected 2026, Gault&Millau 13,5/20 i 2 kape, and Restaurant Croatica — 100 vodećih hrvatskih restorana, 23 puta; each is a hairline card with gold text and each links out to the source listing, since the current site boasts about these with no links at all.
sections.copyDirection: Open with the restaurant's own best sentence, verbatim: Neka Vaša nepca dožive jedinstveni gastronomski užitak mediteranskih specijaliteta u srcu Turopolja. Then tell the real story: Božo iz Skradina, Barica rodom Turopoljka, riba u Velikoj Gorici 1997. kao prava mala revolucija, danas vodi sin Bruno. Pull-quote: dvije kuhinje pod istim krovom, onu mediteransku i kontinentalnu — Bruno Ceronja. Crucially, delete the stale Tradicija duga 25 godina and replace it with a computed line: Od 1997. — gotovo trideset godina. Chef line: Kuhinju već sedamnaest godina vodi chef Goran Marko Beus, rodom Splićanin.

sections.title: Naše ulje, naše vino, naš tartuf
sections.purpose: Dramatise the three owned products that justify the price band and that MICHELIN never mentions, so they are attributed to the restaurant and never to the guide.
sections.layout: A three-card grid, one column under 48rem, each card 4:5 with a full-bleed image, a bottom gradient scrim and text over it — a deliberate echo of the hero so the page reads as one system. Card one, Maslinovo ulje: gallery photo 03, the two labelled Mon Ami bottles against brick, with an olive 1px border, copy on the Skradin grove and the gold medal, and a closing line that the oil, green olives and olive tea can be bought in the restaurant. Card two, Vino: onama1.jpg, the sommelier in front of the bottle wall, an image currently sitting unused in the media library, with copy on 60 etiketa and the house cuvée. Card three, Tartuf: gallery 33, the scorpionfish diptych, or the fuži dish shot, with copy on the native black Turopolje truffle grated at the table. Each card image uses a view() timeline parallax of 6 percent inside a supports guard only. Beneath the grid runs a single full-width hairline strip listing the named local suppliers in Geist Mono micro-caps: OPG BALIĆ — MED, ŽUMBERAK · OPG HAHA — LJEŠNJACI, TUROPOLJE · OPG GOGA — KRUŠKE, TUROPOLJE.
sections.copyDirection: Use the restaurant's own verbatim lines: Kušajte naše extra djevičansko maslinovo ulje iz vlastitog maslinika u Skradinu, nagrađivano zlatnim medaljama; and Vino kuće je cuvee Chardonnay i Graševina iz podregije Pokuplje, vinogorje Vukomeričke gorice. Attribute all of it to the restaurant and never phrase any of it as MICHELIN praise. Supplier strip heading: Većina namirnica dolazi iz kruga do stotinu kilometara.

sections.title: Galerija — the twenty photographs nobody has seen
sections.purpose: Turn the site's largest untapped asset — gallery images 21 through 40, which exist on the server and appear nowhere on the live site — into the visual proof of quality, with real alt text for the first time.
sections.layout: A masonry-feel grid built with CSS grid using grid-auto-rows 8px and per-item row spans declared in markup, so there is no JS masonry and no layout shift. Four columns at 64rem and up, three at 48rem, two below. Twelve curated images rather than forty: the interior (01), the raw fish platter (05), the grilled squid platter in white gloves (12), the olive oil poured beside the lobster (14), the veal on black (18), the carpaccio cone (21), the chef plating octopus (25), the charcoal grill with flames (28), the scorpionfish diptych (33), the blue lobster macro (37), the chocolate torte (40) and the guests toasting (onama2). Every image gets a real descriptive Croatian alt attribute — the single highest-value accessibility and SEO fix available, since all forty are currently empty. Each tile preserves its aspect-ratio, takes a 4px radius and a 1px inset ring, uses loading lazy except the first two, and on hover or focus lifts to scale 1.02 over 240ms on cubic-bezier(0.2, 0, 0, 1) while a caption slides up from translateY 8px and zero opacity. Clicking opens a dialog lightbox with real previous and next BUTTONS rather than swipe-only navigation, satisfying WCAG 2.5.7, plus arrow-key and Escape support and a view-transition-name morph from the tile. Below the grid sit links to Instagram and Facebook.
sections.copyDirection: Section heading Galerija with a subline crediting the photographers: Fotografije: Josip Škof, Mario Žilec i Jakob Goldstein za Mon Ami — correct, and a quality signal in itself. Alt text written properly, for example: Jadranske lignje sa žara s blitvom i krumpirom, posluženo na bijelom ovalnom tanjuru; Kuharica dovršava tanjur hobotnice s roštilja; Živi jastog na zelenoj salati, krupni plan.

sections.title: Dolazak — deset minuta od Zračne luke Zagreb
sections.purpose: Serve the airport-transit guest that MICHELIN and the restaurant both describe, and convert where is it into I can be there.
sections.layout: Two columns. Left holds a self-hosted static map — an SVG or a pre-rendered static tile image of the Trg kralja Tomislava area centred on 45.71137, 16.07998 with a claret pin — deliberately not a Google Maps iframe, which is both an LCP liability and a third-party cookie problem; tapping it opens the real maps app. Right holds a vertical timeline of three arrival routes, each a hairline row with a Geist Mono time figure: AUTOMOBILOM — 8 do 12 minuta od Zračne luke, oko 6 km; AUTOBUSOM — polasci sa Zračne luke svakih 35 minuta, oko 2 €, pa 3 minute hoda od autobusnog kolodvora; ROMOBILOM — gradski električni romobili u neposrednoj blizini. Below runs a four-chip amenity row of Parking, Klima, Pristupačan ulaz and Wi-Fi, plus two honest negative chips in ink-muted: Bez kućnih ljubimaca and Zabranjeno pušenje. The full address is repeated as selectable text with a copy-to-clipboard button and a Kopirano toast.
sections.copyDirection: Lead with the restaurant's own positioning turned into a promise: Deset minuta od Zračne luke Zagreb — taman dovoljno između dva leta. Keep the bus detail in substance from their Kontakt page but rewritten in proper Croatian; the current English paragraph containing aproximately and bus lines that drives must be deleted entirely rather than translated.

sections.title: Prigode — svadbe, krštenja, poslovni ručkovi
sections.purpose: Capture the high-value enquiry stream the current site advertises in one sentence and then gives no way to act on.
sections.layout: A short, calm band on surface-raised with a single two-column split. Left, a four-item list of occasion types as hairline rows with 24px icons: Svadbe i krštenja; Pričesti i krizme; Poslovni ručkovi u separeu za 10; Tematske večere i sezonski dani. Right, a compact enquiry card that reuses the reservation dialog with a preset Prigoda subject and a party-size field that starts at 10. Underneath runs one full-bleed 3:1 image band using 0010.jpg, the long communal table with hands and flutes and no identifiable faces, with the same scrim treatment as the hero.
sections.copyDirection: Anchor on the verbatim line: Mon Ami je idealno mjesto za poslovna druženja, svadbe, pričesti, krizme i krštenja. Then add the practical fact the site never states: Restoran ima 70 mjesta i odvojeni separe za 10 osoba. Za veće skupine javite se telefonom kako bismo dogovorili detalje.

sections.title: Podnožje — contact, hours, structured data, honest legals
sections.purpose: Close the loop on every stale or missing signal: the 2020 copyright, the hidden hours, the absent structured data, the unlinked cookie policy.
sections.layout: A four-column footer grid, two columns under 48rem. Column one: the logo lockup on a cream-safe treatment plus the motto. Column two: the full per-day hours table in Geist Mono with today's row marked by a claret left rule, driven by the same JS clock as the hero chip. Column three: address, landline, mobile, email. Column four: links to Facebook, Instagram, the MICHELIN listing, the Gault&Millau listing, Online naručivanje and Politika kolačića. A bottom bar carries a dynamically generated copyright year, the business registration line, and repeats the theme and language toggles. INVISIBLE BUT CRITICAL: one JSON-LD block of type Restaurant carrying name, image, url, telephone, priceRange of three euro signs, servesCuisine of Mediterranean, Seafood and Croatian, address as a PostalAddress, geo with latitude 45.71137 and longitude 16.07998 at the five-decimal precision Google requires, menu pointing at the on-page jelovnik anchor, acceptsReservations true, hasMenu with the real hasMenuSection and hasMenuItem tree, and openingHoursSpecification as separate objects: Monday opens 11:00:00 and closes 16:30:00; Tuesday through Saturday opens 11:00:00 and closes 23:00:00; Sunday opens 00:00:00 and closes 00:00:00. No aggregateRating at all, because self-serving ratings make the page ineligible for star results under Google's policy while the guide badges do the same job legitimately. The html element declares lang hr, correcting the current site's wrong en-US, with reciprocal hreflang links for hr, en and x-default.
sections.copyDirection: Motto verbatim: Restoran Mon Ami, za vas… kao prijatelj prijatelju. Copyright line: Copyright, the current year generated in JS, Restoran Mon Ami. Sva prava pridržana. Recommend in the handover that monamihr@gmail.com be replaced with info@monami.hr, because a free Gmail address undercuts a menu with a 42 € beefsteak.

signatureMoves: THE LIVE STATUS CHIP AS THE PAGE'S SPINE. One hours object in JS is the single source of truth for four things: the hero chip, the footer's today-highlight, the reservation time dropdown, and the JSON-LD openingHoursSpecification. It computes three states — open, closing within 60 minutes (Otvoreno još 45 min), and closed with the next opening (Zatvoreno — otvaramo u utorak u 11:00) — correctly handling Monday's 16:30 short day and Sunday. It renders on first paint from a tiny inline script so it is never a layout-shifting hydration artefact. No competitor restaurant site in Croatia does this, and it is the single detail that will make the owner say yes.

THE CREAM MENU ISLAND. The menu is the only part of the page that stays paper-light in both themes, with 48px rounded corners so it reads as a physical sheet laid on the dark page. It is a structural joke that works: the restaurant's actual jelovnik, finally on the site, finally looking like a menu — and it solves a real legibility problem, because a 60-row price column scans faster as dark-on-light.

THE PER-KILOGRAM DEFUSER. The 96 € scampi and 62 € squid currently read as portion prices and are the most damaging thing on the live menu. Here each by-weight dish carries a claret per-kg suffix, a po kilogramu pill, and a tap-to-open popover with a weight slider and a live Geist Mono estimate. Two minutes to build; removes the single biggest source of guest anxiety on the entire menu.

SUBGRID PRICE ALIGNMENT ACROSS INDEPENDENT DISH CARDS. Every dish row inherits its parent's column tracks via grid-template-columns subgrid, so dish name, diet tags and price align on the same three axes across all eleven categories with no hard-coded widths. Invisible when it works, instantly cheap-looking when it does not — exactly the precision that separates 2026 from 2019.

THE UNSEEN TWENTY. The gallery is curated almost entirely from images 21 to 40, which exist on the server and have never appeared on the live site: the carpaccio cone on black, the chef plating octopus, the flames under the fish grill, the scorpionfish diptych, the blue lobster macro, the chocolate torte. Every one gets a real descriptive Croatian alt attribute where today there are forty empty ones. The owner gets a visibly new site built entirely from photographs he has already paid for.

TYPE AS THE COAST-MEETS-CONTINENT THESIS. Instrument Serif for the story and for English dish names in italic; Schibsted Grotesk for everything a finger touches; Geist Mono for every single number on the page. Three faces, three jobs — and because Geist Mono is tabular, the ticking clock never reflows and the price column never jitters.
motion: VIEW TRANSITION ON LANGUAGE AND THEME SWITCH. document.startViewTransition wraps the textContent swap for HR/EN and the color-scheme flip, giving a 180ms crossfade of the whole page instead of a jarring repaint. Same-document View Transitions sit at 91.75 percent and fail safe — guard with a check for document.startViewTransition and call the swap directly if absent. Assign view-transition-name only to the header and the hero H1 so those two morph while everything else cross-fades.

LIGHTBOX AND DIALOG MORPH VIA STARTING-STYLE. The reservation dialog and the gallery lightbox enter from a starting-style block of opacity 0 and transform translateY(16px) scale(0.98), transitioning opacity and transform over 220ms on cubic-bezier(0.2, 0, 0, 1) plus display and overlay at 220ms with allow-discrete. The overlay entry is the non-obvious part: without it the top-layer element vanishes instantly on exit rather than animating out. The backdrop pseudo-element gets its own starting-style opacity fade.

SCROLL-DRIVEN SECTION REVEAL, STRICTLY PROGRESSIVE. Section headings and provenance cards rise 20px and fade in using animation-timeline view() with animation-range entry 10% cover 35% — note that animation-duration is ignored with a view timeline, so the range is what controls timing. Scroll-driven animations are NOT Baseline; Firefox still reports version_added as preview. The whole block must sit inside a supports query for animation-timeline view(), and the base rule must never contain opacity 0 or Firefox users get permanently invisible content.

IMAGE PARALLAX AT 6 PERCENT, NOT 30. Provenance and hero images translate 6 percent on the same view() timeline — small enough to read as depth rather than as the 2014 parallax the current site uses, large enough to notice. Also guarded by supports and disabled under prefers-reduced-motion.

STATUS-DOT PULSE. The open-state dot animates box-shadow from a 0-spread ring of oklch(0.74 0.15 150 / 0.55) out to an 8px transparent spread over 2s ease-out, infinite. Animating box-shadow spread on an 8px element keeps it cheap and avoids affecting the pill's layout. Disabled entirely under prefers-reduced-motion: the chip keeps its colour and loses its heartbeat.

STICKY BAR HIDE-ON-SCROLL-DOWN. The mobile action bar translates out by 100 percent on downward scroll past 400px and returns immediately on upward scroll, driven by an IntersectionObserver sentinel plus a single rAF-throttled comparison rather than a raw scroll listener, transitioning over 200ms on cubic-bezier(0.2, 0, 0, 1). It must always be visible whenever a form field in the viewport has focus.

FILTER CHIPS WITH ZERO JS. Diet filters are checkboxes and the menu list uses a has() selector — the container matching a checked filter hides every list item whose data-diet does not include that token. Pure CSS has() at 94.8 percent support means filtering costs literally zero INP, which is the metric 43 percent of sites currently fail.

MENU CATEGORY RAIL AUTO-TRACKING. An IntersectionObserver with rootMargin of -88px 0px -70% 0px marks the active category chip and centres it in the rail with scrollIntoView using inline center and smooth behaviour. Snappy, no scroll listener, and it makes an eleven-category menu navigable with one thumb.

BUTTON PRESS PHYSICS. All primary buttons transition transform over 120ms and background-color over 160ms, scaling to 0.97 on active, with hover tints computed as color-mix in oklch of claret at 88 percent with white — mixing in oklch rather than sRGB is what stops hover states going muddy.
result.darkMode: Dark is the DEFAULT, not an afterthought, and it is defensible for this restaurant specifically: every strong photograph Mon Ami owns — gallery 02, 18, 21, 40, the chef portrait cropped out of bg3D3-08-24 — is shot on black reflective surfaces, and the real trade is the evening service to 23:00. A cream site would frame those photos in white margins and kill them. Implementation: root declares color-scheme dark light, and every token is authored once as light-dark(lightValue, darkValue) custom properties, so a single color-scheme flip retints the entire page with no duplicated rules. A three-state toggle (Auto / Svijetlo / Tamno) lives in the footer and inside the language popover, persisted in localStorage under a ma-theme key and applied before first paint by a four-line inline script in head that sets documentElement.style.colorScheme, so there is no flash. prefers-color-scheme drives the Auto state. Light mode is a genuine second theme rather than an inversion: surface becomes oklch(0.97 0.012 85), the warm cream the actual logo PNG sits on, so the lockup finally stops looking like a sticker; hairlines become oklch(0.88 0.01 85); body text becomes oklch(0.24 0.015 250); and the claret darkens to oklch(0.44 0.18 12) to hold 4.5:1 on cream. Two hard rules. First, the menu section is always paper-light in both themes — a local color-scheme light island with its own surface token — because prices and allergen tags must read like a printed jelovnik at a glance, and white-on-black number columns measurably slow scanning. Second, the open/closed status chip keeps its own fixed colour pair in both themes, verified at 4.5:1 against both surfaces, because it is safety-critical information that must never depend on theme state. Under prefers-contrast more, hairlines swap to currentColor at 40 percent and focus rings thicken from 2px to 3px. Images get no filter in either theme; instead the dark theme adds a 1px inset ring of oklch(1 0 0 / 0.08) on every image container so black-ground photographs do not bleed into the black page.
risks: IMAGE LICENSING IS THE REAL BLOCKER. Every photograph in this concept is credited to Josip Škof, Mario Žilec or Jakob Goldstein on behalf of Mon Ami. Being reachable on the restaurant's own server is not the same as being cleared for a rebuild. The client must confirm rights in writing before launch, and the MICHELIN CDN, Gault&Millau, PutniKofer and Eat Out Zagreb images must not be used at all — they are third-party and some are explicitly all rights reserved.

NO EXTERIOR PHOTOGRAPH EXISTS. There is no confirmed image of the building, entrance, signage or terrace anywhere in the library. The Dolazak section is designed to survive without one, using a static map plus a route timeline, but a single exterior shot would materially improve it. Budget a half-day shoot, or pull one from the Google Business Profile with permission.

THE MENU MAY BE STALE THE DAY IT SHIPS. Prices come from the live Restaumatic system as of 27 September 2026 and have already drifted hard since 2023 — carpaccio 16 to 18,50 €, scampi 80 to 96 €/kg. Several dishes are flagged privremeno nedostupan. The Zadnji put ažurirano stamp is honest but useless unless someone actually updates it, so the handover must isolate the dishes into a single clearly commented JS array a non-developer can edit, and the client must accept that job.

THE SALMON PROBLEM. MICHELIN's inspector singles out the grilled salmon with teriyaki and celery purée, and it does appear on the ordering menu at 23,00 €, but the restaurant's own About copy never mentions it. Confirm with the client before making it a hero dish; if they do not consider it a signature, lead with crni rižoto od sipe, which every single source agrees on.

NO WINE PRICES EXIST ANYWHERE. The concept gives wine a whole card, but the 60-label list is unpublished — not on the site, not in the ordering system, not in any guide. That section can only make qualitative claims until the client supplies the list. The two orphaned menu PDFs on the server are the highest-value unexplored lead and should be OCR'd first.

THREE GOOGLE FONT FAMILIES IS A BUDGET DECISION, NOT A FREE ONE. Even subsetted to latin-ext, three families is roughly 60 to 80KB of woff2. Mitigation: preload exactly one face, use display swap, and ship Fontaine-generated size-adjust fallbacks. If the LCP subpart budget is still tight after field testing, Geist Mono is the one to drop — its job falls back to font-variant-numeric tabular-nums on Schibsted Grotesk, at a real but acceptable loss of character.

SCROLL-DRIVEN ANIMATION IS THE EASIEST WAY TO BREAK THIS PAGE. At roughly 82 percent support and still preview-only in Firefox, any base rule containing opacity 0 permanently hides content for a fifth of visitors. The supports guard is not optional. Test in Firefox stable with the flag off before shipping.

STALE CLAIMS MUST BE CORRECTED, NOT COPIED. Tradicija duga 25 godina is wrong by five years. The MICHELIN streak is reported inconsistently as three, six and seven years across sources, so assert no ordinal at all — just MICHELIN Guide 2026 · Selected. The Gastronaut-only claim of a 1 to 21 August annual closure is single-sourced and must be phoned through before it enters the hours logic, where it would silently tell guests the restaurant is shut for three weeks.

GDPR AND THE COOKIE POLICY. The cookie policy page exists but is unlinked and no consent mechanism loads. Dropping the Google Maps iframe removes the main third-party cookie problem, but if analytics or a reservation widget are added later a consent layer becomes mandatory. Croatian-specific mandatory footer business details such as OIB and registration were not researched and need a legal check.

THE OWNER MUST BE ABLE TO MAINTAIN IT. The current site died because an external contractor owned it and walked away. A single self-contained HTML file is wonderfully robust, but edits mean opening a code file. The deliverable must therefore isolate every editable value — hours, dishes, prices, gallery captions — into one clearly commented configuration block at the top of the file, and the handover must include a one-page Croatian guide to changing a price and a closing time.
